environment: Hermes Native full locked workspace suite: 727 library + 15 automation protocol + 3 launcher tests; all-target locked cargo check; headless two-pane egui interaction.
notes: The headless UI opens work and personal sessions with the same stored session ID in separate side-by-side Dock panes. It verifies each transcript and draft is independently rendered, focuses and types into each composer, and confirms each resulting draft remains attached to its exact Gateway/session/profile owner key. A separate UI test opens a pane owned by another Gateway and verifies an actionable fail-closed state while the active route, profile, transcript and draft remain unchanged. The renderer tests do not send a prompt or validate authenticated live Gateway routing. Packaged Windows acceptance and formal pinned-source pairing remain open; PAR-0086 stays partial.
